task_meta.title: Fix an order-export importer that chokes on (and mis-totals) the real export file

claim_text:
`python -m importer exports/orders_2024-09.csv` now works. The totals are below, and they add up to exactly the 28,478.53 that the export's own closing `TOTAL` line reports.

| Customer | Total |
|---|---:|
| Atelier Moreau | 5,069.40 |
| Baker, Hart & Sons | 6,205.00 |
| Blue Fe
digest: Read 10 files (7 before its first edit), made 2 edits, ran tests 12 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
